events.text: Sculpture installed in presence of artist and crew, 5 to 11 January.

evidence.quote: The sculpture was installed between 5 and 11 January 2009
The sculpture was unveiled informally on 12 January 2009

events.text: Cerny admits he and two friends made the piece; artist identities fabricated.

evidence.quote: On the evening of 13 January 2009 , Černý officially admitted that the piece was actually created entirely by him

events.label: presentation withdrawn
events.text: Official Entropa presentation page withdrawn from Czech presidency website.

evidence.quote: On 14 January 2009 , the official Entropa presentation page was withdrawn

events.text: Sculpture ceremonially launched despite authorship controversy.

evidence.quote: the sculpture was ceremonially launched on 15 January 2009
followed by its official media launch date three days later

events.text: Bulgarian depiction covered with black fabric.

evidence.quote: the Bulgarian depiction was covered with black

events.text: Removal of the sculpture from Justus Lipsius building begins.

evidence.quote: The removal of the sculpture began on 11 May

events.text: Parts loaded into three trucks and transported to Prague.

evidence.quote: on Thursday , 14 May loaded its parts into three trucks

events.text: Sculpture set up again and inaugurated at DOX centre, Prague.

evidence.quote: The sculpture was set up again in the Centre of Contemporary Art DOX in Prague-Holešovice and inaugurated on 11 June 2009

events.text: Begins exhibit at Techmania Science Center, Plzeň.

evidence.quote: Between September 2010 and March 2012 , the sculpture was on exhibit at the Techmania Science Center in Plzeň

events.text: Exhibit at Techmania Science Center, Plzeň ends.
